title: Astro Portal API v1 places of a space
description: A place belongs to the space, like a framing or an item of equipment, and is read and written by `/v1/places` with either credential. The most recent edit wins, the place as one block: every write carries `editedAt`, the instant of the person's gesture on the device; the service keeps the most recent one (an older or equal write is answered `200` with `applied: false` and what the service keeps), and caps `editedAt` at its own clock + 5 minutes. A deletion is soft and answers to the same rule (`DELETE …?at=`). A place used by a plan to execute cannot be deleted (`409 place_in_use`). `usage` is computed at each read, never written. A plan keeps its own copy of the place (`planner-document.schema.json`, `place`), with the same `id`; `note` and `kind` never enter it. The normative prose is `v1.md`, « Places ».

placeId.description: Chosen by the client and never changed: a UUID for a new place, given as soon as its point is set. `known`, `search`, `suggested`, `resolve`, `extract`, `default` and `import` are segments of other routes and are refused as identifiers.

knownType.description: The four types of a known place (the suggested places).

kind.description: The type of the place: « private » (a place of one's own, like a home or a garden: what a new place is by default) or one of the four types of a known place. A place created from a suggested place keeps the suggestion's type. Absent on a place written before the field: clients read it as « private », or as the type of its `knownPlace` when it has one.

horizonMask.description: 36 points, one every 10° of azimuth from 0 to 350, in that order; altitudes in degrees. A point may carry `surveyedAt`, the instant its 10° sector was last surveyed (in augmented reality, or moved by hand in an editor); a point without it is « à relever ».

knownPlace.description: The link to the known place the place was added from; never the known place's details.

skyEntered.description: The sky background the person typed for the place, in mag/arcsec². Rule: measured > entered > estimation.

planRef.description: A plan that names this place (`location.id`), in the shape of a framing's `planRef`.

usage.description: Computed at each read from the plans not deleted whose place is this one: `pendingPlans` are the plans to execute (`active`), which refuse a deletion; `pastPlans` every other plan (executed, partial, abandoned, archived), which keeps its own copy of the place.

placeFields.description: What the person writes. `name` is kept as typed (never trimmed nor rewritten); `elevation` is a decimal string, absent when unknown (never « 0 » for an unknown); `timeZone` is an IANA name or absent (without a time zone the night is computed from the longitude and shown in UTC; an explicit « UTC » is UTC); `timeZoneSource` is « chosen » when the person picked the zone themselves (a zone read by the table or the service never replaces it), absent otherwise.

placeWrite.description: The body of `PUT /v1/places/{placeId}`: the whole place (one block) and the instant of the gesture. `id`, when given, equals the path's. `usage`, `createdAt` and `updatedAt` are the service's and are ignored; any other unknown field is ignored too. `locality`, `elevation`, `note` given empty, and `timeZone`, `kind`, `skyEntered`, `knownPlace` given `null`, read as absent.

place.description: A place of the space, as the service keeps it. `editedAt` is the instant of the last gesture the service kept (capped at its clock + 5 minutes); `createdAt` and `updatedAt` are the service's.

placeList.description: `GET /v1/places`: every live place of the space (deleted ones are absent: absent means deleted), the most recently edited first, and the space's default place — `null` when none was chosen or when it names a place no longer there; the clients then fall back on their own rule (`defaultPlaceOf`).

writeAnswer.description: `PUT /v1/places/{placeId}` (`201` when it created the place, `200` otherwise): `applied` says whether the write was kept; when it was not (an older or equal `editedAt`), `place` is what the service keeps and the client adopts it — `null` when the place was deleted by a more recent gesture (or longer ago than the tombstones are kept, 90 days), in which case the client drops its copy.

deleteAnswer.description: `DELETE /v1/places/{placeId}?at=<instant>`: `deleted: true`, or `deleted: false` with the place when it was edited after `at` (a more recent edit gives the place back).

defaultWrite.description: The body of `PUT /v1/places/default`: a live place's id, or `null` for none, and the instant of the choice (the same rule as a place).

defaultAnswer.description: `PUT /v1/places/default`: what the service keeps, and whether the write was kept.

importRequest.description: The body of `POST /v1/places/import`: what a device or a browser kept without a space, sent once (at the pairing of a phone, at the first sign-in of a browser). Each place carries its own `id` (never changed by the service); at most 200, each id once.

importAnswer.description: `POST /v1/places/import`: the space's places after the import (the shape of `GET /v1/places`'s `places`) and, for each place sent, in order, whether it was created. An id the space already holds — live or deleted — is never changed (`created: false`): the import is idempotent.

error.description: The v1 error envelope. `409 place_in_use` carries the `pendingPlans` that refuse the deletion; `409 place_limit_reached` carries the `limit` (200).
